feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is claimed for it. The candidate is valid and changes only three fields from iteration 0: base_speed 1.6 to 1.3, kd 0.1 to 0.3, and sensor_size 0.008 to 0.012. Each change targets a failure seen in iteration 0. All 60 runs ended off_track, with max_error about 0.063 m against a 0.06 m limit and 1 to 2 line-loss events per run (oval 1.0, s-bend 1.0, slalom 2.0). The kd and sensor_size changes address that drift directly. The base_speed cut is the main risk. The course is about 4 to 5 m and must be covered in under 3 s, which needs roughly 1.5 m/s average. base_speed 1.3 may not reach that pace, so a clean run could still miss the time limit and score lower than a completed run would. That is acceptable for this first exploratory race, because the telemetry (completion_time, max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation) decides the next step. Next revision, depending on the race: if the robot stays on the line (max_error well under 0.06 m, line_loss_events near 0) but completion_time is above 3 s, raise base_speed in steps of about 0.2 (to 1.5 or 1.6) and keep kd and sensor_size. If it still drifts off track on the slalom or s-bend, keep the lower speed and raise kd further (for example 0.3 to 0.5), but only if steering_oscillation stays low. If steering_oscillation rises sharply with kd 0.3, bring kd back toward 0.2 before changing anything else.
requested_changes: If completion_time exceeds 3 s while max_error stays below about 0.05 m and line_loss_events is near 0: raise controller.base_speed in steps of about 0.2 (1.3 to 1.5, then 1.6), keeping kd 0.3 and sensor_size 0.012.

If the robot still goes off_track with max_error near 0.06 m on the slalom or s-bend: keep base_speed at 1.3 and raise controller.kd from 0.3 toward 0.5, provided steering_oscillation stays low; if steering_oscillation rises sharply, lower kd to about 0.2 instead.

If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more per run even with sensor_size 0.012: raise geometry.sensor_size to 0.016 (the largest allowed value) so the footprint covers the tape edge fully, and leave the controller unchanged to isolate the effect.
